questions.a: A FALSE RED AND A STUCK NEEDLE ARE NOT THE SAME COMPLAINT, and the second is the worse one. The false red on the librarian is what made this visible, but a probescan that red every device correctly would still be uninformative if it could never do otherwise. The defect is that the output does not vary with the world.

THE VERDICT ON harbor_master IS CORRECT AND THE ROAD TO IT IS STILL WRONG. harbor_master genuinely has no registered shim, so 'cannot receive' is true of it. Right answer, wrong reason — and a check that reaches a right answer by a road that cannot reach a wrong one has not confirmed anything.

THE WATCH HAD TO BE WRITTEN NOT TO BECOME THE THING THIS TICKET'S OWN SUBJECT REFUSES. probescan's docstring argues that a probe watching all probes is the manager smell — an instrument, run when a hand wants it, not a standing collector. The obvious watch here is to fire probescan periodically and diff the column, and that is precisely the refused shape. The spec written on 2026-08-17 instead reads the output of runs a hand already made: the instrument stays hand-fired and the watch stays passive, and a stuck needle is detected by twenty identical readings rather than by manufacturing twenty readings. Recorded with its sibling finding: sorted_berth was null, so buildme_rides_the_sorted would have refused this ticket's first crossing whether or not the watch was ever specified.

watchme.trigger: every probescan run — the scan is invoked by a hand, so the invocation IS the event; the probe reads the run's own output and nothing polls, and it deliberately does not run probescan itself, because a watch that fires the instrument it watches is the manager smell probescan's docstring already refuses
watchme.enough: when the device column has taken at least TWO distinct values across runs AND has reported 3-resolved for a device that later changed — variance alone is the floor and is not sufficient, because a column can vary for the wrong reason. Stop early and loudly if twenty consecutive runs return an identical column: that is the stuck needle back, and a needle that has not moved in twenty readings is the original defect whether or not the code changed
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against THIS ticket's falsifier: per run, the rung reported for each device, which shim was resolved and by which lane (registered vs DiscoveredShim fallback), and the set of distinct column values seen so far

watchme.consumer: whoever runs probescan before arming a watch, and the ticket mail-arrives-and-what-cannot-marks-itself, whose progress this instrument is what makes visible
